nodes.html: Personal Tax Return — what we can help with
nodes.text: Personal Tax Return — what we can help with

nodes.html: A simple salary-and-one-investment-property return may not need much advice. But complexity arrives fast: you sell a share portfolio (CGT), inherit a property (cost-base), change jobs mid-year (PAYG), receive a distribution from a trust, move overseas (residency), or have a side business. Each event has tax consequences best handled by a specialist, not a mass-market online return.

nodes.html: Whether you are an expat returning, a new resident, or earning income overseas, Australian tax residency rules interact with foreign tax in complicated ways. A specialist ensures your residency status is correctly assessed, foreign income is reported where required, and double-tax relief is claimed appropriately.

nodes.q: Do I need an accountant for a simple tax return?
nodes.a: For a very simple return (one employer, no investments), an online self-lodgement may suffice. But even small complexities — a second job, a small share parcel, a side hustle, or a rental property — usually make an accountant worthwhile. The matching is free, so you can explore your options without committing.
nodes.aText: For a very simple return (one employer, no investments), an online self-lodgement may suffice. nodes.q: I sold shares this year — do I need a specialist?
nodes.a: A CGT event from selling shares benefits from specialist advice — particularly if you have carried-forward losses, used the CGT discount, or have a mixed parcel. The matched agent calculates the correct cost base, applies the discount where eligible, and ensures the CGT event is correctly reported.

nodes.q: I am an expat — can you help with my Australian tax?
nodes.a: Yes. Our network includes agents experienced in residency assessment, foreign income reporting, and double-tax relief. Tell us in the questionnaire that you have foreign income or are changing residency and we will match accordingly.

nodes.q: How quickly will a matched personal tax accountant contact me?
nodes.a: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

nodes.q: Can a personal tax accountant help with super contributions?
nodes.a: Yes. The matched agent advises on contribution caps, deductible personal contributions, and the interaction between super and your overall tax position — so you maximise retirement savings without breaching caps and triggering excess contributions tax.
nodes.aText: Yes. The matched agent advises on contribution caps, deductible personal contributions, and the interaction between super and your overall tax position — so you maximise retirement savings without breaching caps and triggering excess contributions tax.

nodes.q: What if I have multiple income streams?
nodes.a: Multiple income streams — salary, rental, dividends, trust distributions, side business — each have different tax treatment. The matched agent ensures all income is correctly reported, deductions are apportioned properly, and PAYG instalments are set at the right level.
nodes.aText: Multiple income streams — salary, rental, dividends, trust distributions, side business — each have different tax treatment. The matched agent ensures all income is correctly reported, deductions are apportioned properly, and PAYG instalments are set at the right level.

nodes.a: Yes. The matching service is free for individuals. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched agent gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

nodes.a: Yes. If you need to amend a previously lodged return, the matched agent prepares the amendment, explains the reason to the ATO, and manages any resulting adjustment. Tell us in the questionnaire if you need amendment support.
